results.scope: Hypergraphs are finite families of finite sets on an arbitrary vertex type; a Berge-C4 has an injective vertex map and an injective hyperedge map from Fin 4 with v i, v (i + 1) in e i, and no inducedness or linearity condition; saturation quantifies over every absent three-element set; satNumber n is the least size of a saturated hypergraph on Fin n, isolated vertices included.
Closing a three-edge Berge path by an absent set containing its ends gives a Berge-C4; a Berge-C4 uses four distinct hyperedges and four vertices each lying in two distinct hyperedges.

General rooted gluing for any base on Fin n0 and any three-edge block on Fin 5 satisfying the stated hypotheses; Lemma lem:base is used only for the four explicit bases and the block, whose hypotheses are kernel-checked.
For every n >= 9 a saturated hypergraph on Fin n with (3n - 6)/4 = ceil((3n - 9)/4) hyperedges (natural-number division).
